feature: FILM-708 (each Shorts group goes only to the platforms chosen for it)

mutations.name: S1 the resolver sends a group to a platform it does not name
mutations.pattern: a short naming no group takes the first group for its platform

mutations.name: S2 a named group excluded from a platform falls back to the full video
mutations.pattern: sends nothing, not the full video

mutations.name: S3 the Publish screen sends every group to every Shorts channel
mutations.pattern: which channel gets which Shorts group

mutations.name: S4 a group with no platform ticked goes nowhere
mutations.pattern: a group naming no platform goes to every Shorts channel shown

mutations.name: S5 Publish Now uploads a group to a platform it does not name
mutations.pattern: refuses an Instagram cut for a YouTube channel

mutations.name: S6 saving a group drops its platforms
mutations.pattern: keeps the platforms a group goes to
